first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and is supported by two inherited findings showing durable activation and time-to-value gains. Verify memory_86 to confirm applicability and durability, and memory_73 to assess whether promotional pricing produced sustainable qualified revenue rather than primarily short-term acquisition under competitive pressure. Current intent favors onboarding, while preserving the possibility that verified pricing economics justify a change.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified source directly matches the current onboarding decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Signup simplification also previously produced durable SMB activation gains. Promotional pricing is rejected despite competitive pressure because verification revealed 30-day retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive first renewal. The experiment should confirm that these onboarding gains persist in the current account mix before broader rollout.
